final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT f.film_id AS fid, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS c FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.fid AS fid, s1.c AS c, s1.c - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c > s2.a), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.fid AS fid, s3.c AS c, s3.d AS d, s3.c - s4.a AS d2 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c > s4.a) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(d), AVG(d2) FROM s5
